instruction: Candid studio photograph, medium close-up. Against a plain beige background, the curly-haired woman in a white shirt (R1) sits on the left, smiling with her eyes closed while raising her right hand to touch her hair. Beside her, the wavy-haired woman in a black tank top (R3) sits on the right, looking down with a gentle smile and closed eyes. They sit close together under soft, warm studio lighting.
elements: R1 raises her right hand to touch her own hair while R3 does not have that assigned action

R3 sits close beside R1 while looking downward with closed eyes
